description: Set the inset spacing (Innenabstand) of a text frame: inset_mm {top, left, bottom, right}, all four required, 0 or more; and/or the vertical justification (vertikale Ausrichtung, Textrahmenoptionen): vertical_justification top, center, bottom or justify; and/or the first baseline (Grundlinienoptionen) as in create_text_frame: first_baseline_offset (ascent, cap_height, leading, x_height, fixed, embox_top) and min_first_baseline_pt. At least one; what is omitted stays. Returns frame_id, inset_mm, vertical_justification, first_baseline_offset and min_first_baseline_pt read back (get_frame_options reads them under text).

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

first_baseline_offset.description: First baseline offset (Erste Grundlinie, Versatz) as in create_text_frame. Without it the frame keeps its setting.

inset_mm.description: Inset in mm: { top, left, bottom, right }, all required. Optional when vertical_justification is given.

min_first_baseline_pt.description: Minimum first baseline offset in points (Min.). Without it the frame keeps its setting.

vertical_justification.description: Vertical justification of the text in the frame (vertikale Ausrichtung). Without it the frame keeps its setting.

name: set_frame_inset
title: Inset of a text frame
